name: Expert labels to 3D models (clean)
summary: Turns labelled volumes (a CT segmentation, any label map or masks) into a clean 3D model per structure: one coloured GLB scene per case for the 3D view, and STL files for 3D printing.
help: Connect label volumes (NIfTI, NRRD or MHA): a label map per case, where each number is a structure (names from a table: id, name, and optionally group and color), or masks, one file per structure in a folder such as segmentations/ (the file name is the structure, as in the TotalSegmentator dataset). Scans connected by mistake (a CT) are recognised and skipped. Each structure becomes a surface (marching cubes on a slightly softened mask), smoothed without shrinking (Taubin), reduced to at most Triangles, closed at the edges of the scan, and checked: pieces, open edges, watertight, so the table says which models are ready to print. Models are in the patient's frame, in millimetres in STL and metres in GLB (head up, face towards you), grouped as skeleton, organs, vessels, heart, lungs and airways, muscles, and coloured as anatomy atlases do (lungs see-through). Structures picks some by name or group: liver, kidney_*, vessels, skeleton. The 3D scene of a case is kept under Scene triangles (and stored compactly) so it reaches EsaSim and opens quickly; the STL files keep the full detail. Runs on any worker; a full TotalSegmentator case (about 100 structures) takes a minute or two.

inputs.label: Labels
inputs.help: A label map per case, or masks (one file per structure) in a folder such as segmentations/

inputs.label: Names
inputs.help: For label maps: id, name (and group, color as #rrggbb)

outputs.label: 3D scenes
outputs.help: <case>/<case>_anatomy.glb: every structure of the case, named, coloured and grouped, for the 3D view

outputs.label: Models
outputs.help: models.csv: case, structure, group, volume_ml, triangles, pieces, watertight, open_edges, color, note (ready to print or why not)

params.label: Structures
params.help: Names or groups, separated by commas (liver, kidney_*, vessels, skeleton); empty: all

params.label: Smallest (ml)
params.help: Structures smaller than this are listed but not built

params.label: Smoothing
params.help: Rounds of smoothing that keep the volume (Taubin); 0: the voxels' steps stay

params.label: Triangles
params.help: Most triangles per structure (fewer: a lighter scene); 0: no limit

params.label: Scene triangles
params.help: Most triangles in a case's 3D scene (about 3.5 MB at 300,000, so it opens in the browser); the STL files are not reduced. 0: no limit

params.label: Step (voxels)
params.help: 2 or more: coarser surfaces, built faster

params.label: Largest piece only
params.help: Drop small islands of each structure (not for structures made of pieces)
